strategies.name: overnight_range_break_retest_continuation

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: what is the highest point of price action within that range? And then two, what is the lowest point of price action within that range?
entry_sequence.action: Mark the overnight or pre-market high and the overnight or pre-market low from the 4:00 p.m. to 9:30 a.m. EST range.
entry_sequence.rationale: These are the two main zones the speaker says to focus on.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we want to wait for is one for either price to break above that range or we are going to look for price to break below that range
entry_sequence.action: During the New York session, wait for price to break above the overnight high for a potential long, or break below the overnight low for a potential short.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break of the overnight range is the trigger condition.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we want to see it close below or above with strength or weakness
entry_sequence.action: Require the breakout candle to close beyond the level with strength for upside breaks or weakness for downside breaks.
entry_sequence.rationale: The close beyond the range is the speaker's confirmation that price may continue.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we are then going to look for price to pull back and retest that level
entry_sequence.action: After the break, wait for price to pull back and retest the broken overnight level.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker prefers the retest rather than chasing the initial breakout.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we want to see some kind of bullish price action
entry_sequence.action: For longs, enter after the retest shows bullish confirmation at the broken overnight high; for shorts, enter after the retest shows bearish confirmation at the broken overnight low.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest candle must confirm the direction before entry.

stop.transcript_quote: our stop is going to be if price breaks back down below this previous high or vice versa
stop.rationale: The speaker places the stop back beyond the breakout level: below the prior overnight high for longs and above the prior overnight low for shorts.

strategies.stop_management: once you feel comfortable with your first trim, take it, put your stop-loss at break even

confluences.transcript_quote: if the overall trend is to the upside, well then ideally we're not looking for price to break below to look for shorts
confluences.name: trade_in_direction_of_trend
confluences.description: If trend is up, focus on upside breaks; if trend is weak, focus on downside breaks.

confluences.transcript_quote: we want to see it close below or above with strength or weakness
confluences.name: breakout_close_confirmation
confluences.description: The breakout should close beyond the range with strength or weakness before considering an entry.

confluences.name: retest_required
confluences.description: After the breakout, the speaker waits for a pullback and retest of the broken level.

confluences.name: bullish_retest_confirmation
confluences.description: For long setups, the retest should show bullish candle confirmation and elevated volume.

confluences.name: bearish_retest_confirmation
confluences.description: For short setups, the retest should show bearish candle confirmation and elevated volume.
